findings.problem: '对话现已存储在{destination}{retirement}，并已在那里恢复。' The second clause has no subject, so with the retirement clause ('；此处的副本已删除') it attaches to 副本: 'the copy here was deleted, and was restored there'. 恢复 also means restore/recover, so the success notice can read as if the deleted copy came back. Without retirement it reads fine.
findings.fix: '对话现已存储在{destination}{retirement}；对话已在那里继续运行。' (explicit subject; 继续运行 = resumed running, no 'restore' sense)

findings.problem: '疑似机密的内容' while its parent reason_history_secret and the withheld_* lines say '类似机密'; the files-stay variant should repeat the parent's wording.
findings.fix: '未推送的历史中包含类似机密的内容。'
